properties.description: Converted (KAN-9): mes.usp_allocate_scrap_to_orders + rpt.usp_rpt_scrap_yield_weekly + the Copy to curated are replaced by one Spark job (mfg_lake.jobs.scrap_yield_weekly). The job builds the shift calendar itself, recomputes the scrap allocation in-flight for parity/logging (stg.scrap_alloc does not feed the report), and writes snappy Parquet to abfss://curated@kcmfglake.dfs.core.windows.net/manufacturing/scrap_yield_weekly — the same location DS_ADLS_Curated_Parquet (report=scrap_yield_weekly) resolved to.
